scope: Real local API/PGlite/Chrome and strict sandbox with offline fixture generator. No provider calls.
checks: Default Owner prompt opens general generation with actual source and isolated read-only preview
Publish keeps records and URL; public-only bridge can save with existing actions
Same-account fresh CSRF sends one bridge write and reconnects the frame to saved state
Explicit host image selection saves a reference and restores the image after reload
Destructive frame requests need host confirmation; visitor writes request sign-in
Runtime failure repairs once; explicit publication preserves records, image and URL
Explicit cancellation suppresses late preview and preserves the live version
New space description creates a blank space then enters the same generation flow
Optional module gallery still exposes 60 reusable modules separately
